title: Supabase community wall
description: A centred title, grey line and white button over a wall of white, round-cornered post cards (avatar with a small badge, handle, grey text) in five columns set in an arch, the middle one lowest, the outer ones cut by the page edge and faded out at both sides and the bottom. Cards fade in, sharpen from a blur and rise as they scroll into view, the middle columns rising furthest. Phones show the first two columns.
notes: the reveal is a CSS view timeline (inside @supports), so cards simply show where unsupported or with reduced motion
posts are dealt across the five columns in turn; around twenty fill the 620px window
avatars are media slots (round placeholders when empty)
